caption: The drawing features a single cylindrical container set against a plain, beige background. The container has a dark brown or black surface and is depicted with a narrow neck and a flat, round top. Painted on the body of the container is a large red circular shape at its center, flanked on both sides by symmetrical leaf-like or feather-like patterns in green and yellow. Near the top, just below the neck, is a decorative yellow scalloped or wave design that circles the container. The overall composition is simple, with the container centrally placed and occupying most of the vertical space in the image. There are no other objects or details in the background.
title: Toleware Tea Cannister
